regressions_description: Generated regressions: list, show and validate the tests Semantic methods proposed, and incorporate one into the project's Quality checks only with --approve.
regressions_option_approve: Explicit approval of the incorporation (required; without it nothing is executed or written).
regressions_missing_subcommand_fix: Use jgates regressions list, show <run>/<id>, validate <run>/<id> or incorporate <run>/<id> --approve.
regressions_unknown_subcommand_fix: Use jgates regressions list, show <run>/<id>, validate <run>/<id> or incorporate <run>/<id> --approve.
regressions_bad_cwd: The folder does not exist or is not a folder: {path}
regressions_missing_proposal_fix: Pass <run>/<id> as shown by jgates regressions list (for example sem_20261108T120000Z_0123abcd/P1).
regressions_bad_proposal_fix: A reference is <Semantic run ID>/<proposal ID>, as shown by jgates regressions list.
regressions_refused_approval_required: Incorporating {ref} needs the explicit approval; nothing was executed or written.
regressions_refused_approval_required_fi: Review it with jgates regressions show {ref} and jgates regressions validate {ref}, then run jgates regressions incorporate {ref} --approve.
regressions_refused_proposal_not_found: No proposal {ref} in this workspace's Semantic runs.
regressions_refused_proposal_not_found_f: List the proposals with jgates regressions list.
regressions_refused_proposal_tampered: The proposal {ref} changed since its run recorded it (sha256 mismatch); it cannot be incorporated.
regressions_refused_proposal_tampered_fi: Run the Semantic method again to get a fresh proposal.
regressions_refused_already_incorporated: The proposal {ref} is already incorporated as {detail}.
regressions_refused_file_exists: {detail} already exists in the project; nothing was written.
regressions_refused_file_exists_fix: Remove or rename that file, or keep the existing one.
regressions_refused_no_project_config: The project has no jgates.yml; nothing was written.
regressions_refused_config_unreadable: jgates.yml cannot be read or its templates entry is not a list; nothing was written.
regressions_refused_config_unreadable_fi: Fix jgates.yml (jgates config validate) and try again.
regressions_refused_validation_not_execu: The fresh validation of {ref} could not execute the test ({detail}); nothing was written.
Use a Node.js runtime with the permission model (25 or later), then try again.
regressions_refused_validation_unusable: The fresh validation of {ref} did not reach a verdict ({detail}); nothing was written.
regressions_refused_validation_unusable_: Check the output above; a test that cannot load or declares no test is never incorporated.
regressions_text_none: No regression proposals in this workspace's Semantic runs.
regressions_text_method_executed: The method executed it itself (see the proposal's execution).
regressions_text_method_not_executed: The method did not execute it: validate it before incorporating.
regressions_text_detects: It fails on the current source: it shows the defect now.
regressions_text_passes_now: It passes on the current source: it guards against the defect coming back.
regressions_text_incorporated: Incorporated {ref} as the Quality check {tool}. Written:
regressions_text_next: A Quality run (jgates run) now executes it with no model call.
